note: Entering, cleaning and organising data in spreadsheets for small businesses or agencies. Fully entry-level — most postings train on the job once you can show basic Excel/Sheets comfort and typing speed.

Pulling numbers from spreadsheets/databases and turning them into simple charts or summaries a manager can act on. Entry-level roles usually want spreadsheet fluency plus basic SQL; Python/pandas is a strong plus, not always required on day one.

Building and fixing the visual/interactive part of websites, often as freelance gigs (Upwork/Fiverr-style) or a junior role at a small agency. A portfolio of 2-3 real small sites matters more than a degree here.
Setting up and customising WordPress sites for local shops, clinics and small firms in Bhopal/Indore who need a simple website but can't afford a full dev team. Usually paid per project.

Answering customer questions over chat, email or basic ticketing tools for companies that hire remote support staff across India. Entry-level; clear written English and comfort with a computer matter more than technical skill.

Writing captions, scheduling posts and making simple graphics for a small business's or creator's social pages. A good starting point for someone comfortable with phones/apps and basic design tools like Canva or Figma.
Helping design app/website screens or marketing graphics under a senior designer's direction. Entry point is usually a small portfolio of practice designs (Figma), not a design degree.

Processing forms, records and routine paperwork on a computer for a business-process-outsourcing (BPO) firm. Common first formal job in Tier-2 cities; needs reliable computer basics and spreadsheet use, not coding.

category: Freelance web maintenance & basic tech support
note: Ongoing small fixes for existing websites (updating text/images, fixing broken pages, basic troubleshooting) for local businesses. Good recurring income once you've built 1-2 sites and earned trust.

Writing small scripts that automate repetitive tasks (renaming files, scraping data, generating reports) for a small team or as freelance work. A handful of working scripts on GitHub is the usual proof of skill.
Uploading and maintaining product listings (titles, prices, descriptions, images) for sellers on platforms like Amazon/Flipkart/Meesho. Entry-level, spreadsheet- and detail-heavy work.

Teaching school subjects or basic computer/digital skills to others online, live or via recorded video. Clear spoken/written English and comfort explaining things simply matter more than formal teaching credentials.

Clicking through websites/apps to find and clearly report bugs before they go live. A good low-code entry point into the tech industry that still values careful, methodical work over deep coding skill.
